name: uptime
description: Shows how long the system has been running, the current time, logged-in users, and load averages.

flags.description: The exact date/time the system booted.

examples.explanation: Up for 2 days, 2 users logged in. Load averages for the last 1, 5, and 15 minutes: compare them to your CPU core count.

about: Load average counts processes running or waiting for CPU (and briefly, disk I/O). A value of 1.0 per core is full utilization: on 4 cores, 4.0 is busy-but-okay, 8.0 is overloaded. The 15-minute value smooths out spikes and is the most meaningful for trend judgment.
useCases: Quick health check after connecting to a server.
Sanity check load before investigating slowness.
mistakes: Comparing load 1.0 to "100% CPU" — the scale depends on core count.
